columns.name: MESSAGE_DETAIL_LOGS_ID
columns.description: Primary Key for the table. System generated.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TRACKING_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the table IRC_MESSAGE_TRACKING.

columns.name: MESSAGE_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: UMS SMTP message ID for email, Id sent by the provider for SMS, etc. Foreign key to the table IRC_INTERACTIONS.

columns.name: MESSAGE_SUBJECT
columns.description: The subject for the message that was sent to the person.

columns.name: MESSAGE_CONTENT
columns.description: The content of the message that was sent to the person.

columns.name: MESSAGE_API_REQUEST
columns.description: Message API request details of the message sent.

columns.name: MESSAGE_API_RESPONSE
columns.description: Message API response data of the message sent.

columns.name: ERROR
columns.description: Details of any error that was encountered in sending out the message.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_DETAILS
columns.description: Stores the request details, including headers.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
